author: RAFAEL MELO REIS
purpose: Make §Retroalimentação an executable fail-closed state-transition contract that composes existing RLL evidence, gaps, gates, provenance, receipts, rollback and uncertainty controls without replacing their producer authorities.

symbols.name: EXECUTION
symbols.meaning: observable execution with command/environment/input/output/exit state

symbols.name: DELTA
symbols.meaning: bounded change between before and after state

symbols.name: UNCERTAINTY
symbols.meaning: named uncertainty transition with evidence

symbols.name: TOKEN_VAZIO
symbols.meaning: known absence of evidence, decision, implementation or authority; never coerced to zero or PASS

symbols.name: GAP
symbols.meaning: explicit open question with next providence

symbols.name: FALSIFIER
symbols.meaning: condition that blocks or falsifies the scoped hypothesis

symbols.name: GATE
symbols.meaning: formal transition authorization condition

symbols.name: RECEIPT
symbols.meaning: replayable evidence of execution and result

symbols.name: PROVENANCE
symbols.meaning: source/version/hash/authority/transformation lineage

symbols.name: CONTRACT
symbols.meaning: frozen semantics and scope

symbols.name: AUDIT
symbols.meaning: verification distinct from producer assertion

symbols.name: QUALITY
symbols.meaning: repeatability/stability/tolerance/Six-Sigma control

symbols.name: HUMAN
symbols.meaning: dignity/safety/autonomy/child-protection and rights non-regression boundary

symbols.name: ZERO_TRUST_SECURITY
symbols.meaning: inputs and authorities are verified rather than presumed trusted

symbols.name: VALIDATION
symbols.meaning: comparison with baseline/reference/falsifier

symbols.name: ROLLBACK
symbols.meaning: reversible state transition with preserved historical evidence

symbols.name: MATURITY
symbols.meaning: technical/evidence maturity without equating maturity to scientific truth

symbols.name: URGENCY
symbols.meaning: priority may reorder work but may not lower truth/evidence thresholds

symbols.name: BOUNDARY
symbols.meaning: explicit statement of what the result does and does not establish

symbols.name: NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE
symbols.meaning: adverse result preserved as information

symbols.name: KNOWLEDGE
symbols.meaning: information with provenance, test and declared boundary

symbols.name: OBSERVATION
symbols.meaning: observed datum separated from interpretation

symbols.name: DECISION
symbols.meaning: human/contractual decision separated from automatic inference

symbols.name: MUWRITE
symbols.meaning: smallest persistent write that records progress without rewriting history

symbols.name: ATLAS
symbols.meaning: typed position and dependencies inside the whole system

symbols.name: CONTINUITY
symbols.meaning: result feeds the next bounded delta rather than terminating evolution

promotion_rule.expression: ΔI>=0 AND provenance=PASS AND receipt!=empty AND gate=PASS AND falsifier_violated=false AND human_rights_regression=false AND auditability_regression=false AND rollback_ready=true

boundary: § is a project governance/state-transition operator. It does not certify physics, legal compliance, ethics compliance, Six-Sigma certification or independent replication by itself.
